Oneliner

Study errors that occur in various types of electronic memory.
Description

he key goal of the launch is to study errors that occur in various types of electronic memory (MRAM, FRAM, SDRAM, etc.) under conditions of outer space. It also planned to evaluate the effectiveness of various error correction algorithms directly on board.
As a side payload, Skoltech-F will carry a digital camera, a high-speed radio channel, a module for radiative cooling, elements of a photonic onboard data transmission bus, and a number of other modules, some of which intended for future scientific missions.
